messages.author: 61ca29ddd1310b45
messages.subject: Problem printing  estimated model
parts:
Hi Phil,

If you have the chance to help me with an issue, I would appreciate it. 
I am trying to print the estimated model along with global fit statistics. However, I am getting the following message:

> mod19_3PL

Call:
mirt(data = Answer19.mt, model = model, itemtype = "3PL")

Full-information item factor analysis with 1 factor(s).
Converged within 1e-04 tolerance after 75 EM iterations.
mirt version: 1.14 
M-step optimizer: BFGS 
EM acceleration: Ramsay
Number of rectangular quadrature: 61

Log-posterior = -32261.64
Error in cat("DIC = ", x@DIC, "\n", sep = "") : 
  no slot of name "DIC" for this object of class "SingleGroupClass"

The model is:

model <- 'F = 1-40 
PRIOR = (1-40, g, norm,-1.5, 1)'

mod19_3PL <- mirt(Answer19.mt, model, itemtype= '3PL')

The error just appears when I try to print the model. I don't have a problem printing the coefficients, or other objects. 

I appreciate your help.

Juliane

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Problem printing estimated model
parts:
Hi Juliane,

This isn't really a problem, just something I missed in the most recent update when the majority of internal objects were moved. The print() function is just looking for the DIC value in the wrong location, but everything else should be in order. I'll be sure to have this patched in the next major release. Cheers.

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Problem printing estimated model
parts:
G2 won't be computed if the tables are too sparse (which they will be with 40 item), and AIC/BIC are not appropriate when priors are used (hence why DIC attempting to be printed). You can however use M2() to obtain the fit of the model, which gives similar measures to what you would find in structural equation modelling software.

Phil
